desc:
A BigCommerce store redesign gives your existing shop a fresher look and feel without moving your products or changing your page addresses. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds your key pages in a Stencil theme copy and shows you a preview before anything goes live.

## What is a BigCommerce store redesign?

A BigCommerce store redesign changes how your store looks and feels while leaving the catalog and the page addresses alone. Colors, fonts, layouts, product pages and navigation are improved. The products, prices, orders and URLs stay where they are.

That is the key difference from a migration or a rebuild. Search engines and customers still find every page at the same address, so the work improves presentation without disturbing what already works.

## Why an outdated design costs you

Shoppers judge a store in seconds. A dated layout, cramped mobile pages or inconsistent buttons suggest the business is neglected, and visitors hesitate to enter payment details. Slow, image-heavy templates make it worse.

A design that no longer fits your products is also a brand problem. If your range has grown or your audience has changed, the old home page may show the wrong things first. A redesign brings the storefront in line with how you sell now.

## How design changes affect results

Good design directs attention. A clear home page shows best sellers and key categories above the fold. Category pages with sensible filters and spacing help shoppers narrow choices. Product pages with large images, visible prices and a prominent add to cart button reduce hesitation.

Design also affects speed. Properly sized images and a lighter layout make pages load faster, which keeps shoppers on the page. We keep your URLs and titles in place, so the visual change does not disturb your search presence. Results still vary with your products and traffic, so we describe the improvements, not a promised lift.

## What a strong redesign includes

- A short review of your current store and an agreed design direction.
- New colors, fonts and button styles applied consistently.
- A refreshed header and footer.
- A redesigned home page with clear entry points to your range.
- Category page templates with better spacing and filters.
- A product page layout built around images, price and the buy button.
- Custom sections for features such as brand stories or featured collections.
- Images sized for faster loading.
- A cart page and trust layout, in the larger packages.
- A mobile layout check and a URL and title check after launch.

## How we work

We start by reviewing your current store and asking what you like, what you dislike and what customers say. You do not need to supply a finished design. We propose a direction and agree it with you before building.

We then work in a copy of your Stencil theme, so your live store stays untouched. You receive a preview link and give feedback. Once you approve, we apply the new theme. The Basic package refreshes the home page and brand style. Standard redesigns home, category and product pages with custom sections. Premium adds the cart, restyled content pages, a trust and reviews layout and a post-launch check of URLs and titles.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Share stores whose style you admire, and say what you like about them.
- Provide your logo, brand colors and best product photos.
- Review the preview on both a phone and a computer.
- Keep your product titles and URLs unchanged.
- Decide which pages matter most to your sales.

**Avoid:**
- Changing page addresses without redirects.
- Overloading the home page with banners and sliders.
- Using low-quality or mismatched photos.
- Approving the design from a desktop view alone.
- Adding many new apps to achieve a look that the theme can handle.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store with a dated look and a growing catalog, a brand that has rebranded and needs the store to match, and an owner who wants a better design but cannot risk losing search positions on existing pages.

## What we need from you

Your store address, your logo and brand details, and a few examples of designs you like. We never need your password. You add us as a staff user or developer with theme permissions, and we work only on the theme copy until you approve the preview.
